scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: State Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSME) operating in the manufacturing sector.
The enterprise should have started production on or after 1 April 2019.
The enterprise must be in the private, cooperative, joint sector undertaking or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs.
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must fall between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025.
The enterprise must be located in Zone C, D or E of West Bengal (additional provisions apply for Zones A and B).
Application must be submitted within 12 months of the DOCCP or within 12 months of the Banglashree notification, whichever is later.
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy ranging from 15% to 60% for eligible MSMEs, with extra subsidies up to an additional 20% for enterprises wholly owned by women, SC/ST or minority entrepreneurs.
